vignette: A child with compromised immunity is referred for a dental procedure that will be invasive. The parent asks whether the dentist should simply give antibiotics as a standard step.
stem: Which is the most appropriate approach?

options.text: Consult the child's physician about management and decide on antibiotic prophylaxis individually for this patient.
Proceed without contacting the physician because the dental plan is independent of the medical condition.
Give prophylactic antibiotics automatically to every patient without individual consideration.
Never use prophylactic antibiotics, regardless of the patient's risk or the procedure.
